address: B1, 22 Dosan-daero 34-gil, Gangnam-gu, Seoul, 06049, South Korea
bio: At OPNNG, delight your taste buds with hard-to-find rare wines while relishing the overall vibe. The name symbolizes “the opening up of new taste vistas through gastronomy and wine.” Resembling more of a gallery than a wine bar or restaurant, this fine dining venue impresses patrons with an arch-shaped entrance, paintings by renowned artists, and a vast wine cellar that plays host to more than 500 different types of wine. It offers handmade pasta dishes and refined à la carte items....
